hero.headline: Amplify reach, Elevate business
hero.subhead: Bespoke SEO, websites, advertising, and AI-powered follow-up — managed by people who look at your results, not just report them.

points.text: Every strategy starts with what's happening in your market — not a generic package rolled out to everyone.
Pricing and reporting you can understand. Clear pricing agreed upfront, no hidden line items, and reports that explain what happened instead of burying it in numbers you can't use.
AI used where it helps. Automating repetitive work like review follow-up and first-response chat — not replacing judgement on the parts that need it.
Small by design. You work directly with the person managing your account — not passed between departments or juniors as you grow.

services.heading: Core services, plus the AI tools that used to be out of reach.

howWeWork.heading: Four steps. No surprises in between.

steps.name: Discovery
steps.text: We start with a real conversation about your goals, your customers, and what's not working yet — not a checklist.

steps.name: Strategy
steps.text: From there, a plan specific to your market: which services matter first, what a realistic timeline looks like, and what success looks like for you.

steps.name: Implementation
steps.text: SEO, your website, branding, campaigns — built and set live, with you kept in the loop rather than finding out after the fact.

steps.name: Growth
steps.text: Results get tracked, reported honestly, and the strategy adjusts as your business and your market change. This doesn't stop once the site's live.

work.heading: A look at what we build.
work.note: A look at what we build — concept projects showing our approach. Real case studies are coming as projects launch.

finalCta.heading: Ready to grow your business?
finalCta.text: Book a free strategy call — no pressure, no scripted pitch, just a conversation about what's possible for your business and what it would cost to get there.
